sonnet.problem: This story card is about an event outside the passage: Goliath falling to David with a sling and a stone (1 Samuel 17). It adds nothing from 1 Chronicles 20:5 beyond the name already given. So it is an outside passage with a card of its own, and it doesn't move this passage forward. The line 'So that's a name Israel knows' also asserts something the text doesn't say.
sonnet.rule: An outside passage, like a New Testament fulfillment, only rides along in a few words on a card that tells this passage. It never gets a card of its own, and a choice card never asks about it.
